newsitem.title: UK: Electra Investment takes 25 pct of Derby FC.
newsitem.headline: Electra Investment takes 25 pct of Derby FC.

text.p: Private equity market specialist Electra Investment Trust Plc has invested 10 million stg for a 25 percent stake in English premier league soccer club Derby County FC, Electra said in a statement on Tuesday.
The club will use the proceeds to strengthen its squad and to continue to develop its new 30,000 seater stadium and adjacent facilities.

Derby said the move was a step towards a stock market listing over the next two or three years. Under the deal Derby chairman Lionel Pickering sees his stake in the club reduced to 69 percent from around 95 percent.
Derby, a medium-sized club based in the Midlands, won the English league title twice in the 1970s. They returned to the top flight in 1996 and finished in mid-table last season.
